outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative flow cytometric gating plots with gate percentages for identifying B cells and B-cell subsets; there is no quantification across replicates, error bars, or statistical test, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
Panel B shows representative flow cytometric plots identifying plasma cells (PC) with gate percentages; no summary statistics or error bars are shown, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
Panel C shows a representative MBC gating strategy with gate percentages from a single flow cytometry sample; no replicated quantitative data or statistics are presented.

Panel D is a color-coded overlay of representative flow cytometry events (MBC, GC, naive populations) showing marker expression; it is a representative display without quantified replicate statistics.
Panel E shows representative MBC subset gating with gate percentages from a single flow cytometry plot; no error bars, summary statistics, or replicate quantification are presented.
